_description: Per-finding allowlist for scripts/audit/run_all_audits.py HIGH findings. Each entry is a known, human-reviewed item -- either a scanner false positive or accepted/tracked technical debt -- NOT a blanket count baseline. Any finding whose fingerprint is not in this list fails the audit-baseline CI job (fix the code, or add a new reviewed entry here).
_how_to_add_entries: python3 scripts/audit/check_baseline.py extended_audit_report.json ci/baselines/extended_audit_baseline.json --severities HIGH --dump-new -- review the output, then merge the printed entries into this file. Never edit scripts/audit/performance_audit.py or security_audit.py to special-case a finding.
_root_cause: Scoped N_PLUS_ONE_QUERY rows for transaction profiles, purchase delivery term, load lookups, facility browse, and commission browse were removed after the runtime repair. SENSITIVE_DATA_LOGGED rows were removed after the scanner stopped treating static api_key/token prose as a leaked value. The remaining entry is the retired plasticos_buyer_match_engine intake_extension create-in-loop fingerprint. That file is gone; this campaign did not absorb the successor or add a new suppression. Newly visible loop findings from the structural scanner are not listed here.
